title: 第17章 炼丹第18章 嗑药
slug: 开局战五渣我靠空间挂机修仙
content_zh:
丹霞阁内。
“薛掌柜！”秦怀安进门就看到薛掌柜刚刚送走一位客人，就抱拳问候道。
现在秦怀安可以看出超过自己三个小境界修士的修为。但他依然看不出破薛掌柜的境界，薛掌柜应该已经达到炼气九层了。
“秦小友来了。”薛掌柜笑呵呵道，随即一愣，“秦小友没有去黄山剑宗的赤铜矿脉吧？听说赤铜矿脉遭了兽潮，能逃回来的人不足一成。”
“薛掌柜，我上次确实去了那里，遇到兽潮了。所幸运气很好，从兽潮中突围出来了。”
“能回来就好，能回来就好啊。听说黄山剑宗的三个筑基期修士也只有一个逃了回来。”
“还是云田坊市中的筑基高手相助，才击溃了兽潮。否则要是兽潮到了人类区域，不知要有多少人遭殃。”
“秦小友，你突破到炼气五层了？！”薛掌柜突然惊讶道。
刚进来他并未注意到秦怀安的修为，这时一看才发现，竟然已从炼气二层突破到了炼气五层，仅仅过去了不到三个月而已。
伙计王贵听到薛掌柜的话，也惊讶的看着秦怀安，上次过来还和自己同为炼气二层，现在竟然已经到了炼气五层！气抖冷！
“薛掌柜，我逃脱兽潮之后，在百万大山中有一些机缘，侥幸突破。”
“哈哈哈，秦小友因祸得福，气运也是修行的重要条件。”
薛掌柜并未深问秦怀安有什么机缘，然后笑道：“秦小友今天是来出售灵药还是购买丹药？”
秦怀安确实在百万大山采摘到了灵药，一株玄阳花，但他并不准备出售。他以后要是凑够了筑基丹材料，可以拿来找人炼制或者兑换筑基丹。
“薛掌柜，我想试着学习炼制丹药，要买一些炼制回气丹的灵草。”
“哦？秦小友打算学炼丹？”薛掌柜意外道。
以前秦怀安虽然在这里做过一些药材处理的工作，但并未表现出什么炼丹的天赋，而且炼丹是需要资源和时间打磨的。
“秦小友，炼丹可是非常个耗费精力和资源的，你不等自己年龄再大点或者修为提升缓慢的时候再试试？”秦掌柜劝道，他认为秦怀安还年轻，应该把资源先花费在自身修为的提升上。
“多谢薛掌柜关心，我想先试试看自己是否有这个天赋。不知一份回气丹灵草需要多少灵石？”秦怀安问道。
“给你算20灵石一份吧。”

“那我先购买十份。”
“王贵，帮秦小友拿十份炼制回气丹的灵草。”薛掌柜没有再劝秦怀安，他知道年轻人只有亲身经历了失败才会回头。
不过话说回来，秦小友获得机缘不小啊，这些灵草对于以前的秦小友来说也是价值不菲的。
王贵急忙去取来了十份灵药，虽内心不忿，但还是很恭敬的递给了秦怀安。
秦怀安付过灵石后，又购买了一些辟谷丹，正打算和薛掌柜告别。
这时薛掌柜说道：“对了，秦小友，再过三个月，就到十年一次宗门集中选拔弟子的时间了，秦小友到时可以试一下。”
content_en:
Inside Danxia Pavilion.
"Shopkeeper Xue!" Qin Huaian came in and saw that shopkeeper Xue had just seen off a guest, and greeted him with fists in his hands.
Now Qin Huaian can see the cultivation level of monks who are beyond his three lower realms. But he still couldn't see the realm of breaking shopkeeper Xue. Shopkeeper Xue should have reached the ninth level of Qi refining.
"Little friend Qin is here." Shopkeeper Xue said with a smile, then he was stunned, "Young friend Qin didn't go to the red copper veins of Huangshan Jianzong, right? I heard that the copper veins were hit by a beast wave, and less than 10% of the people could escape."
"Shop Manager Xue, I did go there last time and encountered a tide of beasts. Fortunately, I was very lucky and broke out from the tide of beasts."
"It would be great if I could come back. It would be great if I could come back. I heard that only one of the three foundation-building monks of the Huangshan Sword Sect escaped back."
"It was only with the help of the foundation-building masters in Yuntianfang City that we defeated the beast tide. Otherwise, if the beast tide reached the human area, I don't know how many people would suffer."
"Little friend Qin, have you broken through to the fifth level of Qi Refining?!" Shopkeeper Xue suddenly said in surprise.
When he first came in, he didn't notice Qin Huaian's cultivation. Only then did he realize that he had broken through from the second level of Qi Refining to the fifth level of Qi Refining. Less than three months had passed.
When the clerk Wang Gui heard what Shopkeeper Xue said, he also looked at Qin Huaian in surprise. The last time he came here, he and he were on the second level of Qi Refining, but now they have reached the fifth level of Qi Refining! Shivering!
"Shop Manager Xue, after I escaped from the beast tide, I had some opportunities in the Million Mountains and I was lucky enough to break through."
"Hahaha, little friend Qin is a blessing in disguise. Luck is also an important condition for practice."
Shopkeeper Xue didn't ask Qin Huaian deeply what opportunity he had, and then said with a smile: "Is Mr. Qin here to sell elixirs or buy elixirs today?"
Qin Huaian did pick the elixir, a Xuanyang flower, from the Million Mountains, but he was not prepared to sell it. If he collects enough foundation-building pill materials in the future, he can find someone to refine them or exchange them for foundation-building pills.
"Shop Manager Xue, I want to try to learn how to refine pills, and I need to buy some spiritual herbs for refining Qi-reviving pills."
"Oh? Qin Xiaoyou plans to learn alchemy?" Shopkeeper Xue said unexpectedly.
Although Qin Huaian had done some medicinal material processing work here before, he did not show any talent for alchemy, and alchemy requires resources and time to polish.
"Little friend Qin, alchemy requires a lot of energy and resources. Why don't you wait until you are older or your cultivation level improves slowly before you try again?" Shopkeeper Qin advised. He believed that Qin Huaian was still young and should spend resources on improving his own cultivation level first.
"Thank you, Shopkeeper Xue, for your concern. I want to try it first to see if I have this talent. I wonder how many spiritual stones are needed for a piece of Qi Rejuvenation Pill Grass?" Qin Huaian asked.
"Let me give you 20 spiritual stones."
"Then I'll buy ten copies first."
"Wang Gui, help little friend Qin get ten pieces of spiritual grass for refining the Qi Restoration Pill." Shopkeeper Xue did not persuade Qin Huaian anymore. He knew that the young man would only look back after experiencing failure personally.
But having said that, Xiaoyou Qin had a great chance. These spiritual herbs were also valuable to the former Xiaoyou Qin.
Wang Gui hurriedly went to get ten elixirs. Although he was unhappy, he still handed them to Qin Huaian respectfully.
After Qin Huaian paid for the spirit stones, he bought some Bigu Pills and was about to say goodbye to Shopkeeper Xue.
At this time, Shopkeeper Xue said: "By the way, little friend Qin, in three months, it will be the time for the sect to select disciples once every ten years. Little friend Qin can give it a try then."
